card_templates.name: Guided speaking scene
card_templates.purpose: Default template for new beginner speaking cards that teach meaning through a short visual dialogue, then ask the learner to speak.

required_lines.purpose: Cue the situation and make the learner response necessary.
The line the user should learn to produce.

optional_lines.purpose: Natural confirmation that the learner line worked. Keep out of default practice playback unless testing full dialogue comprehension.

visual_rules: Each spoken dialogue line gets its own frame.
Frame 0 shows the scene partner cueing the situation.
Frame 1 shows the learner-character about to say the target line.
Keep frame 1 visible during the model learner line, 'Now you try', recording, and retry.
Frame 2 is optional and reserved for full-dialogue or post-success confirmation.
text_support_rules: Do not show target text before the first attempt.
Reveal target script only after success, manual reveal, or failed attempt feedback.
Keep transliteration hidden by default; expose it through pronunciation feedback or a pronunciation toggle.
On failure, show heard pronunciation and expected pronunciation in Latin characters.
retry_rules: A failed attempt shows a Try Again button.
Try Again records and verifies again without replaying the whole scene.

practice_card_skeleton.prompt: Watch, listen, then try the learner line.
practice_card_skeleton.success_signal: learner speaks the target line after the scene cue
